errors.text_span: сравнение на три категории „най-печеливша ценова стратегия“
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the chart's topic, "най-печеливша ценова стратегия" (most profitable pricing strategy), as the name of the three categories being compared. The three categories are the specific strategies listed on the x-axis ("Ценова стратегия на база разходи", etc.), and the chart illustrates their ratings regarding which is the most profitable.
